decisions.reason: Submitting the project to a developer verification portal does not change any required FAQ copy, including the existing anti-scam explanation.
The false-positive warning remediation is an operational verification task and does not change the approved Mission page content.
Developer verification of the project for a wallet security warning does not alter NFT metadata fields or their accuracy requirements.
The portal submission has no effect on Small Block prize amounts, triggers, eligibility, funding, or ticket-reset rules.
The security-warning verification action does not change ticket accounting, display, allocation, or consistency rules.
The source concerns verification by a security-warning portal, not Chainlink VRF configuration, winner selection, or draw verification.
Submitting the project for false-positive review does not modify mint-success modal conditions, token IDs, or message variants.
The client requests an external developer-verification submission but does not request any change to the About page's security or technology copy.
Although the warning appears during wallet login, the remediation method does not change SIWE authentication behavior, supported flows, or dashboard access.
The developer-verification submission does not change Lit Protocol gating, ownership verification, or NFT-holder book access.
The false-positive warning report and verification submission do not change the connected-wallet USDC approval or mint flow.
The wallet security-warning remediation has no effect on referral-triggered prize ticket issuance or ticket lifecycle rules.
